# Irha Apparels

> B2B custom apparel manufacturing services in Sialkot, Pakistan for brands, wholesalers, importers, retailers, sports clubs and private-label buyers.

## Business model

Irha Apparels provides OEM, ODM, private-label and made-to-requirement apparel manufacturing services. The public website is intended for business buyers rather than consumer retail, and it does not publish fixed consumer prices.

Every quotation is reviewed against product construction, material, order quantity, size ratio, branding, packaging, destination, Incoterm and delivery requirement. A universal MOQ, blanket monthly capacity or fixed production time is not published because these vary by programme.

The manufacturing base is Sialkot, Pakistan. Irha Apparels does not claim factories or offices in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, United States, Canada or Australia. Buyers may request an appointment-based live factory-view video call; availability and viewing scope must be confirmed.

## Public business verification

The official Sialkot Chamber of Commerce & Industry member directory associates IRHA APPARELS with reference/member identifier A-101267. The website presents that directory reference as business-identity evidence only. It does not publish a certificate issue date, renewal date, committee status or product/factory certification from that reference.

Current buyer-facing website contact details are:

- Email: info@irhaapparels.com
- Telephone / WhatsApp: +92 320 411 0066
- Location: Sialkot, Pakistan

## Product manufacturing programmes

- Bavarian and Trachten wear: Lederhosen, Dirndl dresses, Trachten shirts, vests, Janker-style jackets, aprons, kids Trachten and accessories.
- Sportswear and teamwear: football kits, basketball uniforms, rugby kits, cricket uniforms, tracksuits, training wear, club and academy programmes.
- Premium leather apparel: biker jackets, bomber jackets, leather vests, trousers and private-label leather collections.
- Streetwear and activewear: hoodies, sweatshirts, oversized T-shirts, joggers, tracksuits, active sets and custom brand programmes.
- Leisurewear and nightwear: pyjamas, lounge sets, robes, family sets and private-label sleepwear.

Public category hierarchy follows main category, audience or buyer group, product type and individual product pages. Audience groups include men, women, kids, unisex, team and club, accessories and family sets where commercially relevant.

## Materials and product development

Materials are selected after buyer review and may include genuine suede or leather for relevant Bavarian and leather programmes, cotton and cotton blends, polyester performance fabrics, fleece, nylon, linen, velvet and programme-specific trims. Material composition, GSM, colour, finish and testing requirements are confirmed in the approved specification or sample.

Development capabilities can include requirement review, pattern and size grading, sample development, cutting, stitching, embroidery, DTF or other approved print application, woven labels, care labels, hang tags, custom packaging and shipment preparation. Availability and whether a process is in-house or assigned to an approved production partner are confirmed for the specific order.

## B2B inquiry workflow

Buyers can add products from multiple categories to one inquiry cart. Each selected style can include a target quantity, size breakdown, fabric or branding notes and a private tech-pack upload. Accepted tech-pack formats are PDF, AI, EPS, ZIP, PNG and JPG, with a maximum of 25 MB per file.

A submitted multi-item RFQ receives an Irha tracking reference in the format IRHA-YYYY-NNNNNN. Buyer confirmation and administrative lead notification are queued through the secure notification system.

## Trade and compliance

Quotation structures may include FOB, CIF, EXW or DDP where appropriate. The final Incoterm, destination coverage, duties, documentation and commercial responsibility are stated in the written quotation.

Inquiry data and private files are used for quotation, sampling and order communication. Privacy, cookie controls and data-request information are published on the website. Certification, test-report and compliance claims are stated only when documentary evidence is available for the relevant product or programme. Educational references to standards are not company-level certification claims.
